Container.Name: tv-mt5-cloudflared
Container.Overview: Cloudflare Tunnel connector that exposes the signal-bridge webhook to the internet with a stable HTTPS URL and no port-forwarding. Create the tunnel and token in the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard first -- see docs/cloudflare-tunnel-setup.md in the tv-mt5-bridge repo.
Container.Requires: Create a tunnel in the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard and point its public hostname at http://[your Unraid IP]:5080 (the signal-bridge WebUI Port) before starting this container. Optional: skip this container if you already run a Cloudflare tunnel -- just add a public hostname to it.

Config.Name: TUNNEL_TOKEN
Config.Description: Token for the tunnel you created in the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard
